Name: Mouse Movement Fishing
Author: ASUsername
Description:
挥动鼠标比按住按键的方式更好。
Swinging the mouse is better than holding down the buttons.

原版的钓鱼小游戏按住按键浮漂只会迅速上升，没有任何可以操作的空间，只能通过松开按键重新按下的方式来钓鱼，这样会导致浮漂的速度很难把控，这个模组完美解决了这一点，让玩家很容易把控到所需要的浮漂上升速度。
The original fishing game, holding down the key float will only rise rapidly, there is no space for operation, can only be released by the key to re-press the way to fish, which will lead to the speed of the float is difficult to control, this module perfectly solves this point, so that the player is easy to control the needed float rise speed.
